_comment: DECLARED BEFORE ANY WP4 BENCHMARK. Edit = new version + a note in docs/phase2/09. invariant = must hold exactly; hypothesis = directional expectation on EVALUATION seeds (outcome SUPPORTED or REFUTED; refuted ones are reported, never removed); no claim of physical-world safety.

thresholds.basis: outputs are validated; fuzz + property tests
evidence ledger keyed (origin source, origin seq)
fusion max_remote_age_s equals store max_age_s
deterministic simulation + deterministic fusion
no crash in any condition
object-graph walk after each run (as AC-VS-06)
ego cannot see the target during occlusion (geometry)
thresholds.hypothesis: local-only is blind while occluded

thresholds.basis: CCTV sees target; 3-of-4 confirmation delay ~0.4 s of a ~4.5 s window
thresholds.hypothesis: sharing restores a track during occlusion

thresholds.basis: two independent estimates of similar accuracy
thresholds.hypothesis: info fusion beats the best single source when both see the target

thresholds.basis: CI is never much worse than the best input
thresholds.hypothesis: CI is not materially worse than the best single source

thresholds.basis: CI is conservative by construction
thresholds.hypothesis: CI covariance covers the error (nominal 95%)

thresholds.basis: independence approximately true when both sensors are independent
thresholds.hypothesis: B3 is consistent when its independence assumption holds

thresholds.basis: ego first sees the target ~4.5 s into the run
thresholds.hypothesis: sharing makes the first valid track earlier by >= 2 s

thresholds.basis: gap 1.5 m >> sigma
thresholds.hypothesis: cross-source association is precise for well separated pedestrians

thresholds.basis: KF-1 (WP2) persists: 0.4 m is inside the merge gate
thresholds.hypothesis: close pedestrians remain a KNOWN FAILURE of association

thresholds.basis: no worse than local-only
thresholds.hypothesis: fusion adds no ID switches for separated pedestrians

thresholds.basis: KF-2 (WP2): collision-course crossing is not fixed by sharing
thresholds.hypothesis: collision-course ID switches persist under fusion (KNOWN FAILURE)

thresholds.basis: WP2: 0/20 seeds at 1.77 m for single sources
thresholds.hypothesis: no ID switches for a 1.77 m miss

thresholds.basis: echo = fully correlated: information fusion halves P but not the error
thresholds.hypothesis: B3 is overconfident when evidence is correlated

thresholds.basis: CI is consistent for any cross-correlation
thresholds.hypothesis: B4 stays consistent under unknown correlation

thresholds.basis: same
thresholds.hypothesis: B4 stays consistent under partial correlation

thresholds.basis: bias 0.58 m vs sigma ~0.1-0.2 m; chi2 99.9% over 10 pairs
thresholds.hypothesis: the inconsistency monitor flags a constant remote bias within 3 s

thresholds.basis: chi2 99.9% window false-alarm design
thresholds.hypothesis: no false flag on the unbiased control

thresholds.basis: unmodelled bias degrades consistency
thresholds.hypothesis: undeclared bias degrades B3 consistency by >= 5 points

thresholds.basis: declaring the extrinsic uncertainty through the covariance-propagating transform restores consistency
thresholds.hypothesis: declared transform uncertainty restores B4 consistency

thresholds.basis: WP3 admission rejects observations from the future (future_obs)
thresholds.hypothesis: a remote clock 0.3 s ahead is fully rejected: no silent use

thresholds.basis: 0.3 s stale-stamped data misaligns the state by ~v*0.3 = 0.42 m
thresholds.hypothesis: timestamp skew degrades B3 consistency

thresholds.basis: WP3 delivery 0.91 at this link
thresholds.hypothesis: sharing still helps under the degraded link

thresholds.basis: a second path recovers observations lost on the severe direct link
thresholds.hypothesis: relay increases distinct observations admitted

thresholds.basis: 3-of-4 reconfirmation + publish period
thresholds.hypothesis: remote evidence is used again within 1 s after a camera blackout

thresholds.basis: 3-of-4 confirmation on both sources
thresholds.hypothesis: sharing does not add false tracks (pooled over conditions)

thresholds.basis: tens of tracks, pure Python; sandbox CPU, NOT the Jetson
thresholds.hypothesis: fusion cycle fits in 5 ms on the sandbox (not a hardware claim)

thresholds.basis: arithmetic mean ignores covariances
thresholds.hypothesis: naive averaging is no better than information fusion
